post.description:
Use this API to generate an OAuth2 access token.

 Copy & Paste the JSON below in the Request Body: 

 Plain Text {
 \"grant_type\": \"password\",
 \"client_id\": \"YOUR_CLIENT_ID\",
 \"client_secret\": \"YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET\",
 \"username\": \"user@example.com\",
 \"password\": \"your_password\",
 \"scope\": \"store customer\"
 }

client_secret.description: The secret key associated with the client application [REQUIRED]

username.description: Email of seller admin at WMS (Required for password grant) [CONDITIONAL]

password.description: Password of seller admin at WMS (Required for password grant) [CONDITIONAL]

refresh_token.description: Token to obtain a new access token (Required for refresh_token grant) [CONDITIONAL]

access_token.description: Token to be used for authentication

expires_in.description: The number of seconds until the access token expires

refresh_token.description: A token used to obtain a new access token once the current one expires

scope.description: Specifies the level of access granted

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp indicating when the token was created

error.description: The error code indicating the issue; Eg: unsupported_grant_type

error_description.description: A detailed message explaining the error

post.description:
Use this API to create B2B Orders in the Anchanto WMS.

 ### 📋 Request Template (Copy & Paste)

 ```json
 {
 "b2b_order": {
 "number": "B2B-ORD-001",
 "company_code": "COMP123",
 "shipping_type": "standard_delivery",
 "payment_collection_name": "online",
 "currency_code": "USD",
 "supplier_code": "SUP123",
 "delivery_date": "2023-12-31",
 "billing_address_attributes": {
 "first_name": "John",
 "last_name": "Doe",
 "address1": "123 Business Rd",
 "city": "New York",
 "zipcode": "10001",
 "country_iso": "US",
 "state_abbreviation": "NY",
 "phone": "1234567890",
 "email": "john@example.com"
 },
 "shipping_address_attributes": {
 "first_name": "Jane",
 "last_name": "Doe",
 "address1": "456 Warehouse Ln",
 "city": "Los Angeles",
 "zipcode": "90001",
 "country_iso": "US",
 "state_abbreviation": "CA",
 "phone": "0987654321",
 "email": "jane@example.com"
 },
 "order_items_attributes": [
 {
 "sku": "PROD-001",
 "quantity": 10,
 "unit_price": 50.00,
 "item_udfs_attributes": {
 "Color": "Red",
 "Size": "Large",
 "Material": "Cotton",
 "Style": "Casual",
 "Pattern": "Striped",
 "Design": "Flowers",
 "Embroidery": "Yes"
 }
 }
 ],
 "carrier": {
 "carrier_code": "DHL",
 "carrier_name": "DHL Express"
 }
 }
 }
 ```

 #### 2. B2B Order with VAS (Value Added Services)
 ```json
 {
 "b2b_order": {
 "shipping_type": "standard_delivery",
 "payment_collection_name": "online",
 "currency_code": "USD",
 "order_vas": ["Gift Wrapping", "Quality Check"],
 "order_gift_message": "Happy Birthday!",
 "order_items_attributes": [
 {
 "sku": "PROD-001",
 "quantity": 10,
 "unit_price": 50.00,
 "sku_vas": ["Engraving"],
 "sku_gift_message": "To Mom, with love",
 "sku_etching_message": "Name: John Doe"
 }
 ],
 "billing_address_attributes": { ... },
 "shipping_address_attributes": { ... },
 "carrier": { "carrier_code": "DHL", "carrier_name": "DHL Express" }
 }
 }
 ```

 ### 🔧 VAS (Value Added Services) Parameters
 > **Prerequisite:** The tenant setting `vas_enabled` must be turned ON under **Other** configurations. If disabled, all VAS parameters are silently ignored.

 | Parameter | Level | Type | Description |
 |-----------|-------|------|-------------|
 | `order_vas` | Order | Array/String | VAS codes or names to apply at order level. Accepts array or comma-separated string |
 | `order_gift_message` | Order | String | Gift message text. Only when a Gift Message VAS is assigned via order_vas |
 | `sku_vas` | Item | Array/String | VAS codes or names at item level (inside `order_items_attributes`) |
 | `sku_gift_message` | Item | String | Gift message for the specific SKU item |
 | `sku_etching_message` | Item | String | Etching/engraving message for the specific SKU item |

 **Notes:**
 - On **create**, VAS IDs are added to the order/item.
 - On **update**, sending `order_vas`/`sku_vas` **replaces** existing VAS (not additive). Sending blank clears them.
 - At most **one Gift Message VAS** per order and per item; at most **one Etching VAS** per item.

Use this API to create a B2C Order in Anchanto WMS.

 ### 📋 Request Templates (Copy & Paste)

 #### 1. Standard Order
 ```json
 {
 "b2c_order": {
 "shipping_type": "standard_delivery",
 "payment_collection_name": "online",
 "currency_code": "USD",
 "order_items_attributes": [
 {
 "sku": "SKU123",
 "quantity": 1,
 "unit_price": 100,
 "item_udfs_attributes": {
 "Color": "Red",
 "Size": "Large",
 "Material": "Cotton",
 "Style": "Casual",
 "Pattern": "Striped",
 "Design": "Flowers",
 "Embroidery": "Yes"
 }
 }
 ],
 "billing_address_attributes": {
 "first_name": "John",
 "address1": "123 Main St",
 "city": "City",
 "zipcode": "12345",
 "country_iso": "US",
 "state_abbreviation": "NY",
 "phone": "1234567890"
 },
 "shipping_address_attributes": {
 "first_name": "John",
 "address1": "123 Main St",
 "city": "City",
 "zipcode": "12345",
 "country_iso": "US",
 "state_abbreviation": "NY",
 "phone": "1234567890"
 },
 "carrier": {
 "carrier_code": "DHL",
 "carrier_name": "DHL Express"
 }
 }
 }
 ```

 #### 2. Historical Order
 ```json
 {
 "b2c_order": {
 "is_historical_order": true,
 "b2c_order_state": "completed",
 "b2c_shipment_state": "delivered",
 "wms2_order_state": "completed",
 "created_at": "2023-01-01T10:00:00Z",
 "updated_at": "2023-01-02T10:00:00Z",
 "tracking_number": "TRACK123",
 "dispatch_no": "DISP123",
 "dispatch_date": "2023-01-01T12:00:00Z",
 "delivered_at": "2023-01-02T10:00:00Z",
 "originated_from": "Shopify",
 "shipping_type": "standard_delivery",
 "payment_collection_name": "online",
 "order_items_attributes": [
 {
 "sku": "SKU123",
 "quantity": 1
 }
 ],
 "billing_address_attributes": { ... },
 "shipping_address_attributes": { ... },
 "carrier": {
 "carrier_code": "DHL",
 "carrier_name": "DHL Express"
 }
 }
 }
 ```

 #### 3. Order with VAS (Value Added Services)
 ```json
 {
 "b2c_order": {
 "shipping_type": "standard_delivery",
 "payment_collection_name": "online",
 "order_vas": ["Gift Wrapping", "Quality Check"],
 "order_gift_message": "Happy Birthday! Enjoy your gift.",
 "order_items_attributes": [
 {
 "sku": "SKU123",
 "quantity": 2,
 "unit_price": 100,
 "sku_vas": ["Engraving"],
 "sku_gift_message": "To Mom, with love",
 "sku_etching_message": "Name: John Doe"
 }
 ],
 "billing_address_attributes": { ... },
 "shipping_address_attributes": { ... },
 "carrier": { "carrier_code": "DHL", "carrier_name": "DHL Express" }
 }
 }
 ```

 SCENARIOS:
 - Standard Order: Requires shipping_type, payment_collection_name, order_items, billing/shipping addresses.
 - Cross-Border: Add custom_duty, bill_of_exit, eori.
 - UOM Items: Add uom and uom_quantity in order_items.
 - Marketplace (FBM): Set is_fbm_order=true and marketplace_order_date.

 ### 🔧 VAS (Value Added Services) Parameters
 > **Prerequisite:** The tenant setting `vas_enabled` must be turned ON under **Other** configurations. If disabled, all VAS parameters are silently ignored.

 | Parameter | Level | Type | Description |
 |-----------|-------|------|-------------|
 | `order_vas` | Order | Array/String | VAS codes or names to apply at order level. Accepts array `["Gift Wrapping"]` or comma-separated string `"Gift Wrapping, Quality Check"` |
 | `order_gift_message` | Order | String | Gift message text. Only used when the order has a Gift Message VAS configured |
 | `sku_vas` | Item | Array/String | VAS codes or names to apply at item level (inside `order_items_attributes`) |
 | `sku_gift_message` | Item | String | Gift message for the specific SKU item |
 | `sku_etching_message` | Item | String | Etching/engraving message for the specific SKU item |

 **Notes:**
 - On **create**, VAS IDs are added to the order/item.
 - On **update**, sending `order_vas`/`sku_vas` **replaces** existing VAS (not additive). Sending blank clears them.
 - At most **one Gift Message VAS** per order and per item; at most **one Etching VAS** per item.

post.description:
## Async Callback (Webhook)

This endpoint represents the **callback payload structure** that will be sent once async processing is completed.

**Note:**
- This is **not an API you call**
- This is the **payload your system should be able to receive**
- The callback URL must be configured in the system

---

### Behavior

- Triggered after async processing completes
- Sent per request using `request_id`
- Contains results for all submitted records
- Supports **partial success and failure**

---

### Payload Structure

```json
{
 "request_id": "string",
 "api_path": "string",
 "results": [ ... ]
}
```

---

### Field Details

- `request_id` → Unique identifier returned during async request
- `api_path` → API endpoint which was called
- `results` → Array of per-item processing results

---

### Result Object Variants

#### Success
```json
{
 "number": "ORDER123",
 "status": "success",
 "details": {
 "response": "success",
 "message": "Order created",
 "id": 12345
 }
}
```

#### Failure
```json
{
 "number": "ORDER123",
 "status": "failure",
 "error": "Validation failed"
}
```

---

### Important Notes

- Each item is processed independently
- `details` is present **only on success**
- `error` is present **only on failure**
- Response order is **not guaranteed**
- Callback retried up to **3 times** on failure

```json
 },
```

```json
 "api_key": "your-api-key"
 },
 "event": {
 "consignment_type": "inbound",
 "number": "CONS-10001",
 "old_state": "partial",
 "new_state": "completed",
 "event_on": "2026-05-06T10:00:00.000+08:00",
 "time_zone": "Singapore",
 "receiving_date": "2026-05-04"
 },

 {
 "sku": "SKU123",
 "quantity": 100,
 "received_product_qty": 100,
 "batch": "BATCH-01",
 "received_quantity": 100,
 "expiry_date": "2027-06-30",
 "usable_quantity": 98,
 "unusable_quantity": 2,

 "base_line_number": "10",

 "location_code": "BLK-A1"
 }
 ]
}
```

time_zone.description: Current time zone of the warehouse

from_warehouse.description: From warehosue code in case of STO

uom.description: Unit of measurement. UOM of the Product
